text: About 6 million Jews were killed in the Holocaust.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.questionWording: Approximately how many Jews were killed in the Holocaust? (multiple choice: 1 million / 3 million / 6 million / 20 million / not sure)
room.note: Multiple choice. 45% chose about 6 million; 10% guessed higher and 15% guessed 3 million or fewer; 29% were not sure or did not answer. 2019 survey; older data.

truthSource.label: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum
truthSource.oneLine: The Holocaust was the systematic, state-sponsored persecution and murder of six million European Jews by the Nazi regime and its collaborators.
